definitions.explanation: A blood vessel that carries oxygenated blood away from the heart to the body.

examples.japanese: {動脈|どうみゃく}は{心臓|しんぞう}から{血液|けつえき}を{運|はこ}ぶ。
examples.english: Arteries carry blood from the heart.

examples.japanese: {動脈|どうみゃく}{硬化|こうか}は{危険|きけん}な{病気|びょうき}だ。
{頸動脈|けいどうみゃく}で{脈|みゃく}を{測|はか}る。
examples.english: I measure the pulse at the carotid artery.

notes:
MEDICAL TERM:
- {大動脈|だいどうみゃく}: aorta
- {冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}: coronary artery
- {頸動脈|けいどうみゃく}: carotid artery
- {動脈硬化|どうみゃくこうか}: arteriosclerosis

CONTRAST:
- {静脈|じょうみゃく}: vein (carries blood back to the heart)
